transport.title: Getting there
transport.hint: Metro to the centre: about 25 min
transport.text: There is a Metro station at the airport. The journey to Haymarket, Monument or Central Station in central Newcastle takes around 25 minutes. Trains run from approximately 05:30, or 06:20 on Sundays, until midnight.

taxi.title: Taxis
taxi.text: The Arrow Cars desk in the arrivals hall is staffed around the clock. Pick-up and drop-off points are immediately outside arrivals and departures. Fares are fixed and include all charges; major credit cards are accepted.

kids.title: Travelling with children
kids.text: There are 4 baby-changing stations at the airport: 2 before security and 2 in the departure lounge. They are signposted and located beside the toilets.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.text: The free _NCLFreeWiFi network is available throughout the terminal. Faster paid access is provided through _NCLPremiumWiFi and costs £5.

about: Newcastle Airport has a Metro station with connections to the city centre.
